caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rectangular backrest and seat, both upholstered in a reddish-brown material that displays intricate decorative patterns and designs. The backrest features a border of evenly spaced, round golden or brass-colored studs on both vertical sides and two taller pins at the top corners. The arms of the chair are simple, straight wooden pieces. The front legs and the side stretcher are straight and plain, while the front stretcher under the seat is ornately carved with a scrolling, symmetrical pattern. The wood appears to be a natural brown color, with the ornate elements adding detail to the otherwise simple structure. The background is a plain, light color, providing contrast to the chair and highlighting its design.
title: Armchair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
